tax_and_regulatory.metric: California Proposition 13 Base Levy, Annual Cap & Change-in-Ownership Reassessment
tax_and_regulatory.geography_or_scope: Los Angeles County / State of California
tax_and_regulatory.value: 1.0% base levy (+ voter bonds) | Max 2.0%/yr FBYV cap | 100% FMV reassessment on sale
tax_and_regulatory.notes: CRITICAL NNN INSIGHT: Selling triggers full reassessment to sale price. Because the NNN tenant pays property taxes, a sale spikes the tenant's occupancy cost right before 2030–2035 renewal, which sophisticated buyers price into their offer!
